name: @payswap/capability
description: Capability and Network Authority contracts (Work Order P2-W1): the canonical capability fabric — CapabilityDefinition -> ProviderImplementation -> ConnectedCapabilityInstance -> CapabilityObservation, ProviderStateEnvelope (lossless consequential provider-state preservation), explicit versioned execution-mode vocabulary (PASS_THROUGH_NATIVE | COMPOSED_PAYSWAP | OPTIMIZED_MULTI_PROVIDER), the 14-part executable capability declaration law, hierarchical connector capability packs, append-only certification ledger, and the corridor-aware eligibility DISCOVERY PROJECTION (deterministic, versioned, exclusion-reasoned; never an authority). Catalogue data never authorizes an effect (INV-13); observations are evidence, not authorization. AmountSpec wire type is consumed TYPE-ONLY from @payswap/trust (the single accepted sibling import, resolved via tsconfig paths per the accepted P1 integration pattern) — zero runtime dependencies.
